form.label: Sycope NPM - MITRE ATT&CK Mapping
form.description: Map Sycope security alerts to MITRE ATT&CK framework tactics and techniques

search.query: | inputlookup sycope_mitre_tactics | sort tactic_display_order | fields tactic_name

`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $tactic_filter$ mitre_technique_id=* | stats dc(mitre_technique_id) AS observed | appendcols [| inputlookup sycope_mitre_techniques | stats dc(mitre_technique_id) AS total] | eval coverage = observed . " / " . total

panel.title: MITRE ATT&CK Matrix - Observed Techniques by Tactic (Kill Chain Order)

search.query: `sycope_index` $severity_filter$ mitre_technique_id=* $mitre_technique_filter$ | stats count AS alert_count by mitre_tactic, mitre_technique_id, mitre_technique | lookup sycope_mitre_techniques mitre_technique_id OUTPUT mitre_subtechnique | lookup sycope_mitre_tactics tactic_name AS mitre_tactic OUTPUT tactic_display_order, tactic_id | eval technique_label = mitre_technique_id . " " . mitre_technique | eval technique_label = if(isnotnull(mitre_subtechnique) AND mitre_subtechnique!="", technique_label . " (" . mitre_subtechnique . ")", technique_label) | sort tactic_display_order, - alert_count | stats list(technique_label) AS techniques, sum(alert_count) AS total_alerts by mitre_tactic, tactic_id, tactic_display_order | sort tactic_display_order | eval techniques = mvjoin(techniques, " ") | fields mitre_tactic, tactic_id, techniques, total_alerts | rename mitre_tactic AS "Tactic", tactic_id AS "Tactic ID", techniques AS "Observed Techniques", total_alerts AS "Alerts"

panel.title: Alert Distribution by Tactic (Kill Chain Order)

search.query: `sycope_index` $severity_filter$ mitre_tactic=* | stats count by mitre_tactic | lookup sycope_mitre_tactics tactic_name AS mitre_tactic OUTPUT tactic_display_order | sort tactic_display_order

`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $tactic_filter$ mitre_tactic=* | stats count by mitre_tactic, severity | lookup sycope_mitre_tactics tactic_name AS mitre_tactic OUTPUT tactic_display_order | sort tactic_display_order

`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $tactic_filter$ mitre_technique_id=* $mitre_technique_filter$ | stats count AS alert_count, dc(src_ip) AS unique_sources, dc(dest_ip) AS unique_targets, values(alert_name) AS alert_rules, values(severity) AS severities, latest(_time) AS last_seen by mitre_tactic, mitre_technique, mitre_technique_id | lookup sycope_mitre_techniques mitre_technique_id OUTPUT mitre_subtechnique, tactic_id AS mitre_tactic_id | lookup sycope_mitre_tactics tactic_name AS mitre_tactic OUTPUT tactic_display_order | sort tactic_display_order, - alert_count | eval last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval subtechnique = if(isnotnull(mitre_subtechnique) AND mitre_subtechnique!="", mitre_subtechnique, "-") | fields - tactic_display_order | rename mitre_tactic AS "Tactic", mitre_tactic_id AS "Tactic ID", mitre_technique AS "Technique", mitre_technique_id AS "MITRE ID", subtechnique AS "Sub-technique", alert_count AS "Alerts", unique_sources AS "Unique Sources", unique_targets AS "Unique Targets", alert_rules AS "Alert Rules", severities AS "Severities", last_seen AS "Last Seen"
`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $tactic_filter$ mitre_technique_id=* $mitre_technique_filter$ | timechart span=1h count by mitre_technique limit=10

| inputlookup sycope_alert_reference where rule_type="SECURITY" | lookup sycope_mitre_tactics tactic_name AS mitre_tactic OUTPUT tactic_display_order | sort tactic_display_order, mitre_technique, alert_name | fields alert_name, rule_id, mitre_tactic, mitre_technique, mitre_technique_id, mitre_subtechnique, default_severity, default_score | rename alert_name AS "Alert Name", rule_id AS "Rule ID", mitre_tactic AS "Tactic", mitre_technique AS "Technique", mitre_technique_id AS "MITRE ID", mitre_subtechnique AS "Sub-technique", default_severity AS "Default Severity", default_score AS "Risk Score"
